blocks.text: Dawa-sazi ki sanat mein tayyar hone wali dawayein insani sehat ke liye intehai ahem hain. Chemistry batati hai ke dawayein jism ke andar asal mein kaise kaam karti hain. Dawa ki hifazati hudood aur us ki behtareen khurak (dose) ki had dawa ke do bohat ahem pehlu hain: dawa kitni mehfooz hai aur kaise asar karti hai, yeh jan'na yaqeeni banata hai ke woh mehfooz tareeqe se jazb ho aur hadaf bimari par asar kare. Chapter ka yeh hissa in khayalat par baat karta hai, phir zaraat (agriculture) aur sanat (industry) ko dekhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke do ahem pehlu batayein jo chemistry samajhne mein madad deti hai.
blocks.explanation: Us ki hifazati hudood aur us ki behtareen khurak ki had.

items: Chemistry dawaon ka kaam, hifazati hudood aur behtareen khurak batati hai.
